# Upstream specification

`core-api.json` is a YAML-to-JSON conversion (no semantic changes) of
https://github.com/unfoldedcircle/core-api/blob/04b0d08ccc59f3f146aa9ad031d0c87a0502fce7/core-api/rest/UCR-core-openapi.yaml
